CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE + FIX (SHA 8bd74973e8)

Root cause: fetcher.fetch_snapshot → AcliClient.search_issues uses 'acli jira workitem search --jql ... --paginate --json' which returns issue fields WITHOUT the 'comment' field. Jira search API does not return comment data. So in outbound_differ.py _diff_comments, jira_issue.get("comment", {}) is ALWAYS {} on live runs → jira_comments=[] → every local comment re-emitted as add on every pass. DIG-5301 reached 14 comments; Phase-6 9→5→7 churn.

The previous fix (bug 4572) correctly fixed the snapshot KEY lookup ('comment' not 'comments') and the ADF normalization, but assumed the comment field would be present. It is not present on live runs.

The corrupt-state hardening (cedea1e08d, still in place as primary defense) prevents the pass from running at all when prev_snapshot is corrupt. That remains load-bearing.

FIX (SHA 8bd74973e8): outbound_differ.py _diff_comments + compute_outbound_mutations gain an optional 'client' parameter. When the snapshot entry lacks the 'comment' key (live search shape), the differ calls client.get_comments(jira_key) to fetch live comment state (one call per bound ticket with local comments — bounded). On fetch failure: skip comment mutations with loud warning to stderr — never emit blind adds against unknown Jira state. When snapshot carries 'comment' key (fixture/synthetic path): client not called, backward compat preserved. Reconcile.py creates and passes the AcliClient to the differ.

Defense-in-depth: the corrupt-state guard (reconcile.py abort on parse error) remains the primary protection. The differ-level safety invariant is a second layer: even if somehow the differ runs with an empty/partial snapshot and no client, it skips comment mutations rather than emitting blind adds.

4 RED→GREEN tests added in tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_outbound_differ_live_comment_fetch.py. Suite: 744 passed / 1 pre-existing failure / 2 xfailed.
